Recommended Stat per Class

Before you start on making your units, consider the following table as a reference on which ATK to use on your units.

Class ATK Stat Notes
Hunter S-ATK
Fighter S-ATK
Ranger R-ATK
Gunner R-ATK
Force T-ATK
Techer S-T-ATK S-ATK is used to calculate wand normals, and the T-ATK is used to calculate wand explosionHaving more T-ATK allows your crafted Techs to become more potent, as well as powering up your Resta.Techer always struggles to do damage compared to other classes with the same ability affix, so consider HP for your survival.
Braver S-R-ATK Braver can choose between S-ATK and R-ATK, depending on weapon choice.
Bouncer S-T-ATK Bouncer can choose between S-ATK and T-ATK, depending on the weapon choice.The CPA Tempest Raid is affected by Switch Strike, so focusing on S-ATK is also a choice.
Summoner T-ATK Su is best using T-ATK due to how Rykros Takt works.
Hero ATK Hr can focus on all or one of the attack types.Focusing on HP would help a lot.
Phantom T-ATK While Ph have 3 different weapon types, crafted Techs are superior compared to built-in PAs.Focusing on all ATK or just one is another choice, if you don't want to play with crafted Techs.
Etoile S-ATK Despite having a wand, all Et PAs are calculated using S-ATK.

About DQ Units

The DQ Units refers to the ★13 units dropped on Divide Quest - Photoner Assault. On their own, they are weak, but when you equip 3 (doesn't matter which), you'll gain 200 HP, 20 PP, 150 ATK. All rears are, more less have same stat: 10 HP, 1PP and 10 ATK. The arms and legs, however, have varied stat. For attacking purpose, the 40 ATK ones are desirable and they drop relatively often. The 50 and 80 ATK ones, are however, much rarer.

Simple Unit Ability Affixes

The ability formula listed here is just the general idea, feel free to add your own preferable ability, such as replacing Fordruss Glare with Varuna Glare, or S7:Increased Efficiency with S7:ATK Up 2, or Power VI with Power V, Grace Power with Elegant Power. Do remember that the last destination of PSO2 is to collect costumes and Lobby actions!
